apps.localizedDescription:
Stick Nodes is a powerful stickman animator app created with mobile devices in mind! Inspired from the popular Pivot stickfigure animator, Stick Nodes allows users to create their own stickfigure-based movies and export them as animated videos (GIF or MP4)! It is one of the most popular animation apps among young animators!

■ This is the PRO VERSION of Stick Nodes. Extra Pro features include ■
◆ No startup ad
◆ No watermark on exports
◆ Add sound effects to frames
◆ Export to MP4 video (not just GIF)
◆ More stickfigure filters (blur, glow, and more)

■ Features ■
◆ Import and animate images as well!
◆ Automatic customizeable frame-tweening, make your animations smoother!
